<observations>
Date: Jul 15, 2026
* 🔴 User profile: Graphic designer at downtown agency (WFH Thu-Fri), vegetarian 4+ yrs, sleeps 7 hours/night, torn meniscus in left knee, never had a cardiac stress test.
* 🔴 Preferences & Gear: Prefers outdoor running (dislikes treadmills), Garmin Forerunner 265 (RHR 52 bpm), Nike Pegasus shoes (45 miles), dislikes heavy meals pre-workout, prefers coconut water, black coffee, oats, and whole-wheat pasta.
* 🟡 (07:15-20:05) Agent researched beetroot juice, provided calf raise routine, logged shoe mileage, and scheduled training reminder. ✅

Date: Jul 18, 2026
* 🔴 Routine/Preferences: Golden retriever walking companion, indie rock playlist, takes evening magnesium, sets weekly mileage goal (28 miles).
* 🟡 (07:30-20:30) Agent addressed humidity/hydration, anti-chafing balms, stretching benefits, and updated weekly training schedule. ✅

Date: Jul 21, 2026
* 🔴 Gear/Preferences: Merino wool socks, plans to buy new foam roller, trail shoe care needs.
* 🟡 (07:15-17:00) Agent analyzed uphill stride metrics, contrast water therapy recovery data, and updated daily recovery log. ✅

Date: Jul 24, 2026
* 🔴 Key Goal: Half marathon on September 4, 2026. Refuses headphones on busy streets and bouncing waist packs.
* 🟡 (07:15-17:00) Agent retrieved electrolyte pacing info, water bottle options, swimming cross-training metrics, and updated weekly schedule. ✅

Date: Jul 28, 2026
* 🔴 Preferences: High-density foam roller preference, compression sock recovery metrics, steel-cut oats on high-mileage mornings.
* 🟡 (07:15-17:00) Agent summarized myofascial release, reviewed gym bag options, checked stationary bike recovery metrics, and updated recovery schedule. ✅

Date: Aug 1, 2026
* 🟢 (07:15) User asked if post-run stretching should focus more on hamstrings or quads.
* 🟡 (08:00) Agent analyzed hamstring flexibility scores from the last three weekly assessments.
* 🔴 (08:45) User stated they strongly dislike static stretching before a morning track session.
* 🟢 (09:30) User mentioned their current running cap lost its adjustable buckle in the wash.
* 🟡 (10:15) Agent searched local running stores for breathable, moisture-wicking hats.
* 🔴 (11:00) User stated they refuse to wear neon-colored apparel during early morning road runs.
* 🟢 (11:45) User asked about the ideal hydration temperature for hot-weather distance running.
* 🟡 (12:30) Agent calculated optimal electrolyte absorption rates based on ambient humidity and sweat sodium levels.
* 🔴 (13:15) User stated they only drink lemon-infused coconut water immediately following long runs.
* 🟢 (14:00) User mentioned they plan to pick up a replacement running cap at the downtown shop tomorrow.
* 🟡 (14:45) Agent added dark-colored moisture-wicking caps to the active shopping list.
* 🟢 (15:30) User asked if swimming laps is a safe cross-training activity for upper body endurance.
* 🟡 (16:15) Agent retrieved shoulder mobility and stroke efficiency metrics from the cross-training archive.
* ✅ (17:00) Agent successfully updated the monthly training log with all cross-training and nutrition notes.
* 🔴 (18:20) User stated they have never had a cardiac stress test.
</observations>

<current-task>
- Primary: Awaiting user input following the recent monthly log update and medical history note (no cardiac stress test).
- Secondary: Gear shopping list items pending (dark moisture-wicking running cap, insulated water bottles, high-density foam rollers).
</current-task>

<suggested-response>
The assistant should acknowledge the user's update regarding the cardiac stress test or ask how they would like to proceed with upcoming training sessions.
</suggested-response>
